slides.title: The Patrol name is back in America.
slides.body: For 2027 the Armada PRO-4X becomes the Armada Patrol PRO-4X. First Patrol badge sold here since 1969.

slides.title: 75 years of Patrol.
slides.body: Nissan's first Nissan-badged vehicle in America (1962). Everywhere else, it's the Land Cruiser's great rival.

slides.credit: Y62 Patrol shown, not the Armada · Midhun S abraham / Unsplash
slides.title: Same truck as the 2025–26 PRO-4X.
slides.body: Locker, air suspension, 425 hp twin-turbo V6. New: the badge and optional NISMO sliders, rack and wheels.

end.title: A sticker on a real truck.
end.body: My take, and which Armada to buy if you want the hardware without the badge.
